manifest.name: superpowers
manifest.description: Software development skills for planning, test-driven development, debugging, code review, and delivery.

interface.shortDescription: 面向编码智能体的规划、测试驱动开发、调试与交付工作流
interface.longDescription: Use Superpowers to clarify requirements, plan implementations, debug systematically, coordinate development, review code, and verify completed work.
defaultPrompt: Use $superpowers:brainstorming to clarify this idea before implementation.
Use $superpowers:using-superpowers to choose suitable skills for this project.

brainstorming.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.

interface.short_description: 在实现前澄清目标、需求与约束，并形成经过确认的设计方案
interface.default_prompt: Use $superpowers:brainstorming to clarify the requirements and design before implementing this idea.

dispatching-parallel-agents.description: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies

interface.short_description: 将互不依赖的工作拆分并派发给多个智能体并行高效执行
interface.default_prompt: Use $superpowers:dispatching-parallel-agents to delegate independent tasks to parallel agents and coordinate their results.

executing-plans.description: Use when you have a written implementation plan to execute in a separate session with review checkpoints

interface.short_description: 按照书面实现计划分批执行任务，并在各检查点进行审查
interface.default_prompt: Use $superpowers:executing-plans to execute this written implementation plan with review checkpoints.

finishing-a-development-branch.description: Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work

interface.short_description: 完成实现与测试后，选择合适的开发分支集成和收尾方式
interface.default_prompt: Use $superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch to choose how to integrate this completed work and finish the branch.

receiving-code-review.description: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation

interface.short_description: 严谨评估收到的代码审查反馈，核验后再决定是否落实建议
interface.default_prompt: Use $superpowers:receiving-code-review to evaluate this code review feedback and verify the proposed changes.

requesting-code-review.description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements

interface.short_description: 在任务完成或合并代码前请求有针对性的代码审查和验收
interface.default_prompt: Use $superpowers:requesting-code-review to request a focused code review of the current changes against the requirements.

subagent-driven-development.description: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session

interface.short_description: 在当前会话中由子智能体分阶段执行实现计划并接受审查
interface.default_prompt: Use $superpowers:subagent-driven-development to execute this implementation plan with subagents in the current session.

systematic-debugging.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes

interface.short_description: 在尝试修复之前系统复现问题、收集可靠证据并定位根因
interface.default_prompt: Use $superpowers:systematic-debugging to reproduce this problem, gather evidence, and identify its root cause.

test-driven-development.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code

interface.short_description: 先建立失败测试，再用最小代码实现完成功能或缺陷修复
interface.default_prompt: Use $superpowers:test-driven-development to implement this change through a failing test, minimal implementation, and refactoring.

using-git-worktrees.description: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback

interface.short_description: 为独立功能开发或计划执行创建隔离的 Git 工作区
interface.default_prompt: Use $superpowers:using-git-worktrees to set up an isolated workspace for this task.

using-superpowers.description: Use when starting any conversation - establishes how to find and use skills, requiring skill invocation before ANY response including clarifying questions

interface.short_description: 确认当前任务应当调用哪些 Superpowers 工作流与技能
interface.default_prompt: Use $superpowers:using-superpowers to identify and apply the appropriate skills for the current task.

verification-before-completion.description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always

interface.short_description: 声明工作完成之前运行相关验证，并依据实际输出确认结果
interface.default_prompt: Use $superpowers:verification-before-completion to run the relevant checks and verify this work before claiming completion.

writing-plans.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code

interface.short_description: 将明确需求转化为细致、可执行且可验证的分步实现计划
interface.default_prompt: Use $superpowers:writing-plans to turn these requirements into an actionable implementation plan.

writing-skills.description: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment

interface.short_description: 创建、编辑并在部署前验证可复用的 Codex Skill
interface.default_prompt: Use $superpowers:writing-skills to create or improve this skill and verify it before deployment.
